ai.title: Google March 2026 AI: longer Lyria music and product rollouts
ai.description: Google's March update extends generative music to ~3 minutes with section-level control (intros, verses, bridges) across more consumer and creator surfaces.

ai.title: MCP hits 97M installs — agent wiring goes mainstream
ai.description: Anthropic's Model Context Protocol crossed 97 million installs in March 2026, signaling shift from experiment to default infrastructure for tool-connected agents.

ai.title: March LLM wave: GPT-5.4, Qwen3.5, Nemotron, MiMo-V2-Pro
ai.description: Nine text models shipped in March including OpenAI GPT-5.4 (xhigh), Alibaba Qwen3.5 (0.8B–397B), NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super, and open-weight MiniMax-M2.7 / MiMo-V2-Pro same-day drops.

ai.title: NVIDIA GTC 2026: Vera Rubin platform and Nemotron Coalition
ai.description: Jensen Huang cited ~$1T in Blackwell + Vera Rubin orders through 2027; Vera Rubin AI platform, open Agent Toolkit, and Nemotron Coalition (Mistral, Perplexity, Cursor) anchor March keynote.

funding.title: Factory closes $150M Series C for enterprise coding agents
funding.description: Khosla and Sequoia back AI agents for engineering teams — April 2026 round underscores agent-native dev tooling as a funded category.

funding.title: ElevenLabs $500M Series D at $11B valuation
funding.description: Sequoia-led February mega-round cements voice AI as a standalone infrastructure layer for agents and media pipelines.

funding.title: Fundamental $255M Series A at $1.4B on AI compute
funding.description: Oak HC/FT and Salesforce Ventures join February 2026 round for AI computing stack — part of ~17 US AI startups with $100M+ raises YTD.

funding.title: Humanoid robotics funding projected $20B+ in 2026
funding.description: Production deployments (Figure at Amazon, BMW, Mercedes) drive dedicated robotics capital as physical AI exits pilot phase.

tools.title: Mistral Forge: train custom frontier models on private data
tools.description: Enterprise system for full training and alignment from Mistral open bases — positioned against fine-tune-only and runtime-RAG-only customization.

tools.title: Hugging Face smolagents: ~1K lines, code-first agent runtime
tools.description: Models write and execute Python in managed sandboxes (E2B, Docker) instead of heavy JSON tool schemas — minimal-abstraction agent dev trend.

tools.title: Microsoft ASSERT + Agent Control Specification
tools.description: Open trust stack for policy-driven safety evals on agent trajectories and standardized execution limits, HITL, and access controls.

tools.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark: 1 PFLOP, 128GB unified memory on desk
tools.description: Consumer superchip targets local models to ~120B params with 1M-token context — cuts latency and egress for agent workloads.

industry.title: White House National Policy Framework for AI (March 2026)
industry.description: Administration pushes light-touch federal approach, minor protections, IP, and preemption of state laws deemed burdensome — Commerce evaluation timeline still lagging.

industry.title: DOJ AI Litigation Task Force vs state AI statutes
industry.description: January 2026 task force sole remit to challenge state laws on commerce, preemption, or unlawful burden — escalates federal–state AI federalism fight.

industry.title: FDA narrows oversight for qualifying AI medtech
industry.description: 2026 guidance may lighten paths for some AI-enabled clinical tools as HHS acts on prior RFI — Wilson Sonsini flags compliance shifts for digital health.

industry.title: 2026 AI legal shift: innovation to compliance
industry.description: Baker Donelson frames 2026 as accountability year after hype — enterprises face harmonized EU/US expectations on governance, children, and IP.

oss.title: Hugging Face Spring 2026: State of Open Source
oss.description: Hub growth, sovereign AI initiatives (e.g. South Korea champions trending), and science communities heating on protein folding and drug discovery models.

oss.title: Red Hat AI validated models collection — March 2026
oss.description: Curated third-party generative models certified for Red Hat AI portfolio — enterprise path for governed open-weight deployment.

oss.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra on Hub: 550B total, 55B active
oss.description: NVIDIA open model for long-context agentic reasoning — GTC Taipei wave emphasizes factories, deskside, and coalition-built frontier OSS.

oss.title: Hub scale: 2.2M+ models, 80% downloads from top 50
oss.description: 92% of downloads under 1B params; NLP 58%, CV 21%, audio 15% — embeddings and sentence-transformers still dominate production RAG stacks.
